headline: Paraguayan Senate Impeaches President Santiago Peña Amid Bank Collapse Scandal
summary: Paraguay's Senate voted 44 to 1 to impeach and remove President Santiago Peña from office amid a criminal investigation into the collapse of Ueno Bank. Vice President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as head of state, and judicial authorities ordered Peña's arrest.
why: Political upheaval and bank failures in emerging market nations can trigger severe sovereign risk repricing, currency volatility, and domestic credit contraction.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: The ousting of the sitting president and banking crisis directly impacts national political and economic stability.
